questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: How the ancient Egyptians built the pyramids
The Rosetta Stone and hieroglyphs
Napoleon's army in Egypt
Why the British Museum is so popular
questions.why: They discuss the Rosetta Stone and how it unlocked the Egyptian writing system.

questions.q: Who found the Rosetta Stone in 1799?
options: British Egyptologists
A Coptic priest
Jean-François Champollion
Napoleon's soldiers
questions.why: Sam says Napoleon's soldiers unearthed the rock in the town of Rosetta in 1799.

questions.q: What does the writing on the Rosetta Stone actually describe?
options: Great wisdom from the famous Egyptian philosophers
How the ancient Egyptians built the great pyramids
An agreement that priests didn't have to pay taxes
The story of a famous war between Egypt and Greece
questions.why: Rob says it describes an agreement exempting priests from paying taxes to the King.

questions.q: According to Richard Parkinson, what did people expect to find in Egyptian writing?
options: Great, mysterious wisdom
Lists of taxes
Chinese words
Stories about pharaohs' wars
questions.why: He says people expected the script to contain 'great, mysterious pearls of wisdom'.

questions.q: Why was the Rosetta Stone the key to understanding hieroglyphs?
options: It had a small picture next to each word
It had the same text in Greek
It was the biggest stone ever found
It explained the rules of the language
questions.why: Rob says the messages were written in three scripts, including Greek, which scholars already knew.

questions.q: According to Penelope Wilson, what helped Champollion succeed?
options: Money from the French government
Help from British scholars in Egypt
Talent, love of Egypt and family support
Years of living in Egypt
questions.why: She calls him a prodigy with a fascination for Egypt, encouraged by his older brother.

questions.q: What did Champollion argue in an early lecture?
options: That Coptic was related to ancient Egyptian
That hieroglyphs were like Chinese
That the Stone was a fake
That Greek came from Egyptian
questions.why: Wilson says he was one of the first to argue that Coptic was related to ancient Egyptian.

questions.q: What does the story about Champollion running through Paris suggest?
options: He was afraid that the British would stop him
He hadn't really finished the work at all
He wanted to become famous across Europe
He had worked extremely hard and was overwhelmed
questions.why: He worked so hard that when he finished he shouted 'I've done it!' and collapsed unconscious.
